dataset_name: AgriConnect Lesotho Crop Market & Sales Dataset
description: Comprehensive agricultural market, sales, agronomic, and pricing dataset tailored to the Lesotho highland farming economy.
objective: Empower farmers to optimize crop sales pricing, forecast market demand, and maximize revenue velocity in the digital era.
geographic_coverage: All 10 Districts of Lesotho (Maseru, Berea, Leribe, Mafeteng, Mohale's Hoek, Quthing, Qacha's Nek, Mokhotlong, Thaba-Tseka, Butha-Buthe)

features.name: record_id
features.description: Unique transaction and farm record identifier (AGC-xxxxx)

features.name: historical_avg_price_lsl
features.description: Baseline regional historical average price in Maloti

features.name: competitor_supply_tons
features.description: Estimated district-level competitor supply in the market

features.name: market_demand_index
features.description: Consumer demand index derived from wholesale purchasing activity

features.name: transport_cost_lsl
features.description: Logistics cost to transport produce to urban market center

features.name: actual_price_per_kg_lsl
features.description: Realized market selling price per kg (primary regression target)

features.name: revenue_lsl
features.description: Net sales revenue generated (sales volume * price - logistics)
